_doc: Robot body, motors and physics. Every value has a source: measured (on Pixel), derived (computed from measurements), header (copied from an SDK header), firmware (copied from AutoPark.cpp) or ASSUMPTION (not measured - update after measuring). Edit 'value' only.

track_width_m.note: middle of left wheels to middle of right wheels

skid_factor.note: 4-wheel skid-steer turns slower than ideal diff-drive; effective track = track_width_m x skid_factor (0.45 m). Fitted in the earlier sim to the observed turn behaviour, not measured directly

wheelbase_m.note: front-to-rear axle spacing; NOT measured. Used only for the 'all wheel contact points inside PARK' check

motor_gain_l.note: relative strength of the left side

motor_gain_r.note: right ~5% faster: the robot veered left ~6 cm per metre (Encoder Accuracy runs, 2026-11-19)

thr_straight_l.note: Min Drive: PWM at which the left side starts moving, straight

kinetic_ratio.note: once rolling, the threshold drops to this fraction (static vs kinetic friction)

tau_up_s.note: time constant speeding up (motor + robot inertia)

tau_down_s.note: time constant slowing down under drive

tau_coast_s.note: time constant when the motor output is 0 (coast). Sets how far the robot rolls after stop()

motor_stall_l_t.note: left motor stalls from this time (s); -1 = never

motor_stall_r_t.note: right motor stalls from this time (s); -1 = never

dt_s.note: the NRL runtime ticks at 100 Hz (LineTuning.h: 'robot ticks (10 ms each at 100 Hz)')

stuck_s.note: no motion for this long while not DONE/FAULT = STUCK

seq_chain.note: 0: sequential() advances one child per tick. 1: chains finished children in the same tick
